summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature without running any repository code or tests, and without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, shared _create_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads); tests/test_progress.py (14 new tests before the __main__ block); docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Added entry, PR 1759). The diff is additions only. Unverified: tests, black, isort, and mypy were not run. Known caveats: mode 'tr' returns a binary reader because the exact-string rule was followed; typing.BinaryIO has no readinto in typeshed, so mypy will likely flag the reader's readinto call; the reader defines mode and name properties because typing.IO declares them abstract. Next step: run pytest, black, isort, and mypy on the changes.
